annotations.title: Get Team Media by Tag and Year

description: Retrieve a team's media filtered by both tag and season year. Use to fetch a single year's Impact/Chairman's submission package or other tagged media.

media_tag.description: TBA media tag identifier used to filter team-submitted media. Common tags include 'chairmans_video', 'chairmans_essay', 'chairmans_presentation', and 'imagery'. See https://www.thebluealliance.com/apidocs for the full list.

team_key.description: FRC team key formatted as 'frc' followed by the team number with no leading zeros (e.g., 'frc86', 'frc254', 'frc1114'). Uniquely identifies a FIRST Robotics Competition team on The Blue Alliance.

year.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

name: get_team_media_by_tag_year
